purpose: Real-source pretraining matched compute and source-time audit for parallel time-age architecture
source: UCI PRSA 2017 Beijing multi-site air quality dataset
source_observed_action_tensor_semantics: 13 observed channel availability flags and a source-known sine hour feature; NOT actions
source_event_admission: observed PM2.5 and at least 12 valid current channels; source-current-only
observed_target: 13 real next-hour physical measurements plus real next-hour observed-channel fraction
source_missing_channel_loss: mask 13 physical outcome channels; train 0.1 coefficient on observed fraction
normalization: source timestamps 2013-03-01 to 2014-03-01 EXCLUSIVE, no fit-period target exposure
matched_stream_write_masks: all true for parent and candidate, isolates temporal embedding from write-admission changes
prospective_fit_activation: DISABLED until full-shape complete forward/back/gradient-clipping/AdamW FLOP parity and source authorization
